title: Damaged items
pick_company: Which company did it come from?
pick_purchase: Which purchase did it arrive in? (optional)
stock_unchanged: No stock change — the goods were already sold
customer_balance_unchanged: Customer balance unchanged — record a credit if they are owed one
no_price_to_prefill: No bought price for this material — type the amount you agreed
void_explanation: The stock this record removed comes back, and a company no longer owes for it. A damage that was paid back cannot be voided.
totals_unvalued: {{count}} with no price to value them
edit_closed: This record cannot be edited once its return has been recorded — void it and record it again.
who_us_hint: A loss for us — nothing more
who_company_hint: They owe us what it cost until they pay it back
edit_texts_only: Only the reason and the notes can be changed. To change the quantity, the date or who did it, void this record and record it again.
owed_hint: It is on their account as money they owe us, and it counts as a cost until they pay it back.
confirm_money: They paid us back in money: a payment on their account clears what they owe for this damage.
confirm_materials: They replaced the goods: what they owe for this damage is cleared and the stock comes back.
